verdict.rationale: jo's llms.txt reportedly documents 'ZDR model routing', meaning zero-data-retention routing to model providers. That policy implies user data is not retained by providers and so not used for training, but it appears only as a one-line mention in a probe summary. The per-user isolated machine (jo-docs-13) concerns data separation, not training use, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used to train jo's or third-party models, a user-facing opt-out or control, details of ZDR scope and providers, and independent corroboration.
